title.zh: 2026 IEPL 物理专线抗骨干网 QoS 限速深度实测：上海与广州核心双入口网络拓扑解析
title.en: 2026 IEPL Dedicated Line QoS Bypass Architecture: Shanghai & Guangzhou Dual Ingress Deep Dive

cluster.zh: IEPL 双向物理专线评测集群

description.zh: 从上海电信与广州移动两大核心骨干 POP 入口拓扑切入，深度拆解 2.5Gbps IEPL 跨国内网专线如何通过二层内网隧道物理绕开公网 GFW 审查与晚高峰 QoS 队列丢包。
description.en: A deep-dive technical analysis of 2.5Gbps IEPL point-to-point dedicated circuits, examining Shanghai and Guangzhou POP topology, Layer-2 encapsulation, and peak-hour QoS bypass mechanisms.
